title: land leaves a host's local main in step with origin/main after it pushes (second-project run)
goal: After land pushes in a project whose local main holds commits not yet on origin, local main is fast-forwarded or land names the divergence before its push, never after
notes: Run finding 22: land: left main 2 commit(s) behind origin/main: it cannot fast-forward (fatal: Not possible to fast-forward, aborting.); finding 23: the push sent the whole local history of HEAD.
